When does Sultan Fatih air on TRT 1?

TRT lists Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı for Tuesdays at 20:00 Turkey time.

Turkey uses UTC+3. The slot corresponds to 17:00 UTC. Episode Journal maintains the episode dates below and links each record to the official TRT episode or preview.

How we record dates and times

The calendar uses Episode Journal’s editorial episode records. TRT is the primary source for the weekly broadcast slot, episode identity, official episode pages and previews.

TRT’s Giriş and Güncelleme timestamps describe when a webpage was posted or updated. They are separate from the television broadcast date and from subtitle upload times.

For example, TRT’s Episode 87 webpage displays 7 October 2026, while our episode calendar records the original broadcast on 6 October 2026.
